t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Mbi Nsi-meh pah-aneh tsunkene me ngeh ngonke-yeh. Nji yanengeh mangleh nwu te meteneh, Nsih peh nchi ne metiem eh chemeh, mangleh nfomeh, nsi peh mbeh tsu yi mbe chiki nfoh. Nsi yi tsih langna yoh koh tchipo le tsoyoh mbo-oh kwalemeh mbo ngeh, mbo-oh wa me-meh.
